metas.name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Since they enjoyed the first film, they will love this visually stunning sequel that expands the multiverse adventure.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: This features a unique animation style similar to Spider-Verse and a hilarious, heartwarming story about a family bond.

metas.name: Moana
metas.description: Like Encanto and Sing, this features incredible music and a brave protagonist on an epic adventure across the ocean.

metas.name: The Sea Beast
metas.description: A grand high-seas adventure that fans of Puss in Boots: The Last Wish and Rio will enjoy for its action and charm.

metas.name: Castle in the Sky
metas.description: As fans of Studio Ghibli, this classic adventure film offers a magical story of floating cities and brave heroes.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: Since they liked The Borrowers and other Ghibli films, this beautiful adaptation about tiny people is a perfect fit.

metas.name: Wolfwalkers
metas.description: A beautifully hand-drawn Irish folklore tale that shares the mythical and nature-focused themes of Princess Mononoke.

metas.name: Song of the Sea
metas.description: A gentle and magical animated film about family and folklore that resonates with the tone of My Neighbor Totoro.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 2
metas.description: They enjoyed the first film's humor and action, and this sequel delivers even more excitement and character development.

metas.name: Shrek 2
metas.description: Widely considered one of the best sequels, it expands the fairytale parody world they enjoyed in the original Shrek.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: Combines high-tech action like Spider-Verse with the heartwarming character relationships found in The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: Despicable Me
metas.description: A funny and sweet story about a reformed villain that matches the energy and humor of The Bad Guys.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Fans of Tangled and Encanto will enjoy the strong family themes, magical powers, and catchy musical numbers.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A bright and sunny fantasy about friendship and sea monsters that has the same whimsical feel as Ponyo.

metas.name: Turning Red
metas.description: This modern coming-of-age story features great music and family dynamics similar to the ones in Sing and Encanto.

metas.name: The LEGO Movie
metas.description: A fast-paced, creative comedy that captures the same fun-filled energy as The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious twist on superhero tropes that fans of The Bad Guys and The Meteor Man will find very entertaining.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A visually spectacular musical based on Chinese mythology that fans of Coco and Sing will appreciate.

metas.name: The Princess and the Frog
metas.description: Filled with jazz music and adventure, this is a great match for kids who loved Rio and Tangled.

metas.name: Whisper of the Heart
metas.description: A cozy Studio Ghibli drama about creativity and young love, perfect for fans of Only Yesterday and Kiki's Delivery Service.

metas.name: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
metas.description: An epic adventure with strong environmental themes that will appeal to fans of Princess Mononoke.

metas.name: Pom Poko
metas.description: A whimsical and funny Ghibli tale about shapeshifting raccoons that captures the charm of their existing watch history.

metas.name: Vivo
metas.description: A colorful musical adventure about a honey bear on a journey to deliver a love song, similar in vibe to Rio and Sing.

metas.name: Trolls World Tour
metas.description: An explosion of music and color that will delight fans of the Sing franchise and KPop Demon Hunters.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: A wacky and inventive comedy with a unique visual style that fans of Rango and Mario will enjoy.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A thrilling and emotional adventure about the bond between a boy and a dragon, perfect for fans of Brave.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A magical Disney musical that celebrates the power of dreams, aligning with the themes in Encanto and Tangled.

metas.name: Migration
metas.description: A fun, family-focused road trip movie about ducks that captures the comedy and bird-centric fun of Rio.

metas.name: Chicken Run
metas.description: A clever and exciting escape adventure from the same studio behind Wallace & Gromit.

metas.name: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
metas.description: A breathtakingly artistic Studio Ghibli film that offers a moving story for fans of The Wind Rises.

metas.name: Porco Rosso
metas.description: This Ghibli classic about a pilot in the Adriatic Sea blends adventure and history, appealing to fans of The Wind Rises.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A incredibly charming and polite family comedy that shares the warmth of films like My Neighbor Totoro.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: A rare sequel that surpasses the original, offering a feel-good story that is universally beloved by kids.

metas.name: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
metas.description: A wordless, slapstick sci-fi comedy that matches the humor and style of Wallace & Gromit.

metas.name: Raya and the Last Dragon
metas.description: An action-heavy fantasy quest with a strong female lead, perfect for fans of Princess Mononoke and Brave.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A playful and surreal fantasy about a girl who travels to a kingdom of cats, similar to the magic of Spirited Away.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: A creative and imaginative story that helps kids confront their fears through a magical adventure.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A sweet journey through beautiful landscapes to return a Yeti home, appealing to fans of Kung Fu Panda.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A funny and insightful animated musical about a class lizard that will resonate with fans of Sing and The Bad Guys.

metas.name: Mulan
metas.description: A classic Disney adventure with great action, comedy, and a legendary hero that fits their love for animated epics.
